videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, around 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences covering the key points.
Key points from the transcript:
1. Police conducted raid/seizure (압수수색) on Central and Local Election Commission offices regarding ballot paper shortage during local elections
2. The shortage happened at Jamsil polling station - they printed only 50% of eligible voters (1900 ballots for 3800 voters) instead of the guideline amount
3. Evidence boxes with printed quantities were supposed to be preserved but Election Commission already collected and sent them to disposal companies
4. Court tried to secure evidence on-site but failed because the boxes were already removed/cleaned up
5. There was no manual for handling ballot shortages, and distribution failure was also a problem - some places had excess while Jamsil had severe shortage (500+ ballots short)
6. Songpa-gu office had documents showing they ordered 60% printing for Jamsil 3/4-dong due to low early voting rates, but actual distribution was only 1400 ballots instead of required 1921
I need to summarize this in 3-5 sentences, around 500 characters, in Korean only.
